Name: RandomSlimes
Author: ChrisMzz
Description:
Randomize colours of Slimes (Big Slimes now included!) in the Mines, Skull Caverns, Quarry Mines, Woods or just about anywhere!

Woods are turned off by default, but everything can be customized through Generic Mod Config Menu.

This mod was made to be used along with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20930/]Slime Minerals[/url], my other mod on Slimes adding more minerals to their drop pools.

Source code : [url=https://github.com/ChrisMzz/StardewValleyMods/tree/main/RandomSlimes]GitHub repo[/url]
